codes.note: Likely a typo for SOFR; not defined in the legend.

note: The column holds reference rate plus spread, with fixed-rate loans printing only a percent. Tags show n1 equals the spread in every L, SOFR and C row. For the plain '#%' shape n1 equals interest_rate, interest_rate_cash and spread, so it is a fixed coupon. For 'L+#% PIK' the tags equal pik_rate, so n1 is treated as a PIK spread. For 'L+#% (incl. #% PIK)' n2 matches pik_rate.
